about.eyebrow: Our Values • Our Culture • Our Commitment
about.title: About {store}
about.lead: All Spices • Dry Fruits • Healthy Foods. Pure Roots, Pure Trust, Pure Health.

founder.name: Sunder Singh Chauhan
founder.imageAlt: Sunder Singh Chauhan, Founder and Managing Director of {brand}
founder.commitment: We believe leadership is not about giving orders; it is about setting standards, taking responsibility and inspiring people. At {brand}, we commit to putting customers, quality and integrity before everything else.
founder.promise: To deliver pure, natural and healthy food products to every family with honesty and care.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To become a trusted and respected food brand by delivering pure, natural, healthy and quality food products to every family.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To make quality food accessible to everyone through honesty, innovation, customer satisfaction and responsible business practices.

principles.title: 10 Leadership Principles
principles.body: The values that guide every product we make and every family we serve.

quality.title: Quality First
quality.body: Never compromise on product quality, purity or food safety.

customer.title: Customer Comes First
customer.body: Build customer relationships through trust, service and satisfaction.

honesty.title: Honesty & Transparency
honesty.body: Maintain fair pricing, truthful communication and ethical business practices.

longTerm.title: Think Long-Term
longTerm.body: Focus on building a trusted brand rather than chasing short-term profits.

innovation.title: Innovation & Improvement
innovation.body: Continuously improve products, packaging, marketing and customer experience.

teamwork.title: Teamwork & Respect
teamwork.body: Encourage teamwork, responsibility and respect for every employee.

ownership.title: Ownership & Accountability
ownership.body: Take responsibility for every decision, commitment and result.

trust.title: Customer Trust is Our Asset
trust.body: Every product delivered should strengthen our reputation.

sustainable.title: Sustainable Growth
sustainable.body: Support responsible sourcing, reduce unnecessary waste and grow sustainably.

lead.title: Lead by Example
lead.body: Leadership means demonstrating discipline, integrity, dedication and commitment through actions.

mantra.title: {store}, Pure Trust
mantra.quote: “We don’t just sell food; we build trust with every product.”
mantra.line: Purity in Products. Honesty in Business. Trust in Every Home.

about.closing: Pure Roots, Pure Trust, Pure Health.
